meta.title: RFQ to Auction Conversion: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that user's role context
Repeat the conversion as a Buyer in a separate user session and compare the outcomes
Verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that user's role context; Repeat the conversion as a Buyer in a separate user session and compare the outcomes; Verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan

steps.note: Open a suitable existing RFQ event so the conversion action can be inspected.
Check whether the current user's event menu offers the conversion action.
Attempt the RFQ-to-Auction conversion for the current session.
Assert that the conversion attempt did not produce an application error for the current session.
